sentences.text: Alleging willful disobedience of the order dated 01.10.2014 passed in writ petition No. 7677/2012(PIL) present contempt case is filed.

The writ petition was disposed of in the following terms:-
 (i) The State Government is directed to appoint  Designated Officer, Food Commissioner and Food  Analyst in accordance with the provisions of the Act of  2006 and the rules made thereunder.

(ii) The Union of India is further directed to provide  financial assistance to the State Government for  establishment of Food Laboratory and upgradation of  Food Laboratories in accordance with law dated  20.12.2012 and 09.01.2013, so the existing food  laboratories may be accredited by the National  Accreditation Board.
(iii) The Union of India is further directed to make  financial assistance available to the state for the  establishment of 10 Divisional Food Laboratories.

(iv) The State Government is further directed to  follow and implement the provisions of Act of 2006  and the rules made thereunder.
 (v) These directions be followed and complied with  within a period of six months from the date of receipt of  copy of the order.
 (vi) The respondent shall file compliance report in this regard before the Principal Registrar of this Court.

At the outset learned counsel for the petitioner fairly submits that so far as directions contained in paragraphs 20 (ii), (iii), (iv), (v) and (vi) are concerned, they are complied with by the respondents.
It is however submitted that the respondents have not complied with the direction contained in paragraph 20(i) of the order in writ petition.

It is urged that the State Government has not appointed The High Court of Madhya Pradesh (Sambhagiya Nagrik Upbhogta Margdarshan Manch Gwalior Vs. Shri Bhanu Pratap Sharma) Designated Officer, Food Commissioner and Food Analyst in accordance with the provisions of the Act of 2006 and the Rules made thereunder, namely,G.S.R.1516(E).

opennyai_summary.decision:
The writ petition was disposed of in the following terms:-
 (i) The State Government is directed to appoint  Designated Officer, Food Commissioner and Food  Analyst in accordance with the provisions of the Act of  2006 and the rules made thereunder.
On being noticed, respondents have filed their reply.
As regard to appointment of Designated Officer, it is contended on behalf of respondents that in furtherance to notification no. l] d] uh 2.1.2 (d) dated 13.12.2017 issued by the Central Government published in the Gazette of India dated 15.12.2017, the Commissioner, Food Safety and Standards, State of M.P. by order dated 23.02.2018 has appointed Sub-Divisional Officer as a Designated Officer under the Act.
Since the order passed in writ petition No. 7677/2012(PIL) has been complied with, no further adjudication is warranted.
In view whereof, proceedings are dropped.
Rule nisi is discharged.
